mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter خ?
mcq.explanation: The letter خ is called khaa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ الطَّعَامَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أُحِبُّ الطَّعَامَ (uhibbu T-taʿaam) means: I like food.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word اِسْمَعْ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: اِسْمَعْ is read ismaʿ and means listen.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ (al-jawwu mumtir) means: The weather is rainy.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable دَ?
mcq.explanation: دَ is read da.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ mean?
options: I go to school on Monday.
There are seven days in a week.
mcq.explanation: فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ (fii l-usbuuʿi sabʿatu ayyaam) means: There are seven days in a week.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أُسْرَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أُسْرَةٌ is read usra and means family.

mcq.q: What is a paragraph?
options: A group of sentences about one idea
mcq.explanation: A paragraph is a group of related sentences about one idea.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word أَبٌ (ab) mean?
mcq.explanation: أَبٌ (ab) means father.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word خَلْفَ (khalfa) mean?
mcq.explanation: خَلْفَ (khalfa) means behind.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ is read ilmis anfaka and means touch your nose.

mcq.q: How do you read the shadda in the word jad-dun?
options: The letter daal is said twice
mcq.explanation: A shadda doubles the letter, so jadd has two d sounds.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بَيْضٌ (bayd) mean?
mcq.explanation: بَيْضٌ (bayd) means eggs.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "My hand is small."
mcq.explanation: يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ (yadii Sagiira) means: My hand is small.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'I have a brother and a sister'?
mcq.explanation: ʿindii means 'I have', akh is brother, wa is 'and' and ukht is sister.

mcq.q: What should you check on a food chart before posting it?
mcq.explanation: Checking the words helps to avoid mistakes.

mcq.q: What is a good aim in a reading contest?
options: To read as loudly as possible
To read as fast as possible
mcq.explanation: Accuracy and smoothness matter more than speed.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ (al-jawwu ghaa'im) means: The weather is cloudy.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word اُخْرُجْ (ukhruj) mean?
mcq.explanation: اُخْرُجْ (ukhruj) means go out.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "This is my hand."
mcq.explanation: هَذِهِ يَدِي (haadhihi yadii) means: This is my hand.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word جَدَّةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: جَدَّةٌ is read jadda and means grandmother.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "This is a party."
mcq.explanation: هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ (haadhihi hafla) means: This is a party.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "oranges"?
mcq.explanation: بُرْتُقَالٌ (burtuqaal) means oranges.

mcq.q: Which is a good way of reducing food waste?
options: Take only what you can eat
mcq.explanation: Taking only what you can eat and saving leftovers reduces waste.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word حَلِيبٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: حَلِيبٌ is read haliib and means milk.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable قَا?
mcq.explanation: قَا is read qaa.

mcq.q: In a short speech, what does the sentence anaa fii S-Saffi r-raabiʿ mean?
mcq.explanation: Saff means class and raabiʿ means fourth.

mcq.q: Which Kiswahili word comes from the Arabic word kitaab?
mcq.explanation: The Kiswahili word kitabu (book) came from Arabic kitaab. The other words are Bantu words.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ mean?
options: On the table there is a cup.
In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
mcq.explanation: عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ (ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub) means: On the table there is a cup.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ا?
mcq.explanation: The letter ا is called alif.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word رِيحٌ (riih) mean?
mcq.explanation: رِيحٌ (riih) means wind.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "mouth"?
mcq.explanation: فَمٌ (fam) means mouth.

mcq.q: Which Arabic writing style is used in most printed books and newspapers?
mcq.explanation: Naskh is clear and round and is used for most printed books.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "What is your name? (to a girl)"
mcq.explanation: مَا اسْمُكِ؟ (maa ismuki?) means: What is your name? (to a girl)

mcq.q: What does aghsilu wajhii mean?
mcq.explanation: aghsilu means I wash and wajhii means my face.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "please, go ahead"?
mcq.explanation: تَفَضَّلْ (tafaddal) means please, go ahead.

mcq.q: Which of these is a position word?
mcq.explanation: ʿinda means at. The other words are things.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable مُو?
mcq.explanation: مُو is read muu.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word عَمٌّ (ʿamm) mean?
mcq.explanation: عَمٌّ (ʿamm) means father's brother.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مُفِيدٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مُفِيدٌ is read mufiid and means useful.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word الْخَمِيسُ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: الْخَمِيسُ is read al-khamiis and means Thursday.

mcq.q: Which family word is written أُخْتٌ?
mcq.explanation: أُخْتٌ is ukht, sister.

mcq.q: Which word do you say to tell a friend it is now their turn?
mcq.explanation: dawruka means 'your turn'. dawrii means 'my turn'.

mcq.q: Which is a non-verbal cue?
mcq.explanation: Gestures, facial expressions and body movements are non-verbal cues.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ح?
mcq.explanation: The letter ح is called Haa.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word كَعْكَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: كَعْكَةٌ is read kaʿka and means cake.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْمِفْتَاحُ فِي الْخِزَانَةِ mean?
options: Do not play with the knife.
The chair is at the door.
The key is in the cupboard.
mcq.explanation: الْمِفْتَاحُ فِي الْخِزَانَةِ (al-miftaahu fii l-khizaana) means: The key is in the cupboard.

mcq.q: Which of these letters does NOT join to the letter after it?
mcq.explanation: raa joins only to the letter before it. So do alif, daal, dhaal, zaay and waaw.

mcq.q: Which polite word means 'excuse me' when you want to speak?
mcq.explanation: ʿafwan is used to say 'excuse me' or 'pardon' before speaking.

mcq.q: Which letter completes the word _َمٌ to make fam (mouth)?
mcq.explanation: The word fam (فَمٌ) starts with faa, which has one dot above.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word طَمَاطِمُ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: طَمَاطِمُ is read tamaatim and means tomatoes.

mcq.q: Which letters can make a vowel long?
mcq.explanation: Alif, waaw and yaa lengthen a matching short vowel.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ (at-taawilatu Sagiira) means: The table is small.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word نَافِذَةٌ (naafidha) mean?
mcq.explanation: نَافِذَةٌ (naafidha) means window.

mcq.q: What is the difference between ح (Haa) and خ (khaa)?
options: khaa has a dot above and Haa has none
Haa has a dot above and khaa has none
mcq.explanation: khaa is Haa with one dot above.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word سِكِّينٌ (sikkiin) mean?
mcq.explanation: سِكِّينٌ (sikkiin) means knife.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مَطْبَخٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مَطْبَخٌ is read matbakh and means kitchen.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word كُوبٌ (kuub) mean?
mcq.explanation: كُوبٌ (kuub) means cup.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنِي mean?
mcq.explanation: أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنِي (asmaʿu bi-udhunii) means: I hear with my ear.

mcq.q: Which is a good way of caring for household items?
options: Wash cups and plates after use
Leave a knife within reach of small children
mcq.explanation: Cleaning items after use helps them to last and keeps the home safe.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مُشْمِسٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مُشْمِسٌ is read mushmis and means sunny.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بُرْتُقَالٌ (burtuqaal) mean?
mcq.explanation: بُرْتُقَالٌ (burtuqaal) means oranges.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ث make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ث makes the sound th as in think.

mcq.q: What is the correct reply to shukran (thank you)?
mcq.explanation: ʿafwan means 'you are welcome' and is the polite reply to thanks.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْقِطَّةُ تَحْتَ السَّرِيرِ mean?
options: The cat is under the bed.
The book is on the table.
The pen is in the bag.
The lamp is above the table.
mcq.explanation: الْقِطَّةُ تَحْتَ السَّرِيرِ (al-qittatu taHta s-sariir) means: The cat is under the bed.

mcq.q: In what order do you say the letters when you spell an Arabic word aloud?
mcq.explanation: We spell Arabic in the direction it is written, from right to left.

mcq.q: Which word do you use for 'This is ...' before a feminine word such as shams?
mcq.explanation: haadhihi is used with feminine words and haadhaa with masculine words.

mcq.q: Which is the best answer to kayfa haaluka?
mcq.explanation: The question asks how you are, so the answer says 'I am well, thanks be to God'.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مُمْطِرٌ (mumtir) mean?
mcq.explanation: مُمْطِرٌ (mumtir) means rainy.

mcq.q: What is meant by reading pace?
options: How fast or slow you read
mcq.explanation: Pace is the speed of reading.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "good morning"?
mcq.explanation: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ (sabaahu l-khayr) means good morning.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "food"?
mcq.explanation: طَعَامٌ (taʿaam) means food.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ mean?
options: In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
On the table there is a cup.
mcq.explanation: الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ (al-baytu kabiir) means: The house is big.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I like my house."
mcq.explanation: أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي (uhibbu baytii) means: I like my house.

mcq.q: What does the word ghadan mean?
mcq.explanation: ghadan means tomorrow. amsi means yesterday.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence مَا أَجْمَلَ الْبِيئَةَ mean?
options: The sun is in the sky.
And the rain is from the sky.
mcq.explanation: مَا أَجْمَلَ الْبِيئَةَ (maa ajmala l-bii'a) means: How beautiful the environment is!

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "neck"?
mcq.explanation: رَقَبَةٌ (raqaba) means neck.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I clean my teeth."
mcq.explanation: أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي (unadhdhifu asnaanii) means: I clean my teeth.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word ابْنٌ (ibn) mean?
mcq.explanation: ابْنٌ (ibn) means son.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَبِي يَعْمَلُ mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: أَبِي يَعْمَلُ (abii yaʿmalu) means: My father works.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ is read sabaahu l-khayr and means good morning.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word صَدِيقٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: صَدِيقٌ is read sadiiq and means friend.

mcq.q: What happens to the voice at the end of a statement?
mcq.explanation: In a statement the voice falls at the end. In a question it rises.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The chair is at the door."
mcq.explanation: الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ (al-kursiyyu ʿinda l-baab) means: The chair is at the door.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word دَوْرِي read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: دَوْرِي is read dawrii and means my turn.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word عِنْدَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: عِنْدَ is read ʿinda and means at (near, by).

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The house is big."
mcq.explanation: الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ (al-baytu kabiir) means: The house is big.

mcq.q: Which two letters begin the names of the days of the week in Arabic script (the word 'the')?
mcq.explanation: al- is written with alif and laam.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "on"?
mcq.explanation: عَلَى (ʿalaa) means on.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ (ummii tatbukhu) means: My mother cooks.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word رَقْصٌ (raqs) mean?
mcq.explanation: رَقْصٌ (raqs) means dance.

mcq.q: Which sound is made at the back of the throat like the ch in the Scottish word 'loch'?
mcq.explanation: The letter khaa makes the throat sound kh.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The chair is new."
mcq.explanation: الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ (al-kursiyyu jadiid) means: The chair is new.

mcq.q: Which phrase do you use to thank the audience?
mcq.explanation: shukran li-istimaaʿikum means 'thank you for listening'.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "tooth"?
mcq.explanation: سِنٌّ (sinn) means tooth.

mcq.q: What is a class portfolio?
options: A folder of the class's best work
mcq.explanation: A portfolio keeps work together to be shown and reviewed.

mcq.q: What does al-jawwu mumtir mean?
mcq.explanation: mumtir means rainy.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ (anaa bi-khayr) mean?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ (anaa bi-khayr) means I am well.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَشْرَبُ الْمَاءَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أَشْرَبُ الْمَاءَ (ashrabu l-maa'a) means: I drink water.

mcq.q: Which word fills the gap in: ashrabu ____ (I drink the juice)?
mcq.explanation: We drink juice, not cake, a party or a balloon.
